name: Just-in-Time Curriculum
description: Replaces long study plans with a single lesson pegged to whatever you're actually stuck on right now. Suits people whose reading list keeps growing while the project stalls; less use if you genuinely need broad grounding in a subject before starting.

official.title: Just-in-Time Curriculum by Sultanov
official.description: Throws out stacked prep lists and replaces them with the one lesson the next real problem requires. For people who keep studying instead of building.
